Drag on the canvas (Shift keeps proportions) and set Fill / Stroke in the options bar.

cards.summary: Large rounded leaf set on a diagonal, with a small notch at the upper left, a curved white slit at the lower left that separates a base lobe, and no veins or stem. Solid black, one piece, about 1.07 to 1.
avoid: no stem or veins: add white lines for detail
diagonal shape: rotate it for an upright look
cards.applies_to: shape layer / vector path: drawn with the Custom Shape tool as a Shape layer (Fill and Stroke stay editable, it scales without loss); Path mode gives an outline for clipping or vector masks, Pixels mode paints it into a pixel layer. It is not an effect and does nothing to photo content by itself.
cards.how_to_apply: By script (the route PGD used for the thumbnail): load <Photoshop 2026 install folder>/Required/Legacy Shapes and More.csh as custom shapes, then Action Manager make on a contentLayer whose shape is a customShape descriptor with this name, this ID ('95dd6b62-e968-11d5-ae01-d27616e26b81': the .csh file stores it as $95dd6b62-e968-11d5-ae01-d27616e26b81, the PGD renderer passes it without the $) and Top/Left/Btom/Rght pixel bounds plus a solidColorLayer fill; the library must be loaded first. In the interface the Custom Shape tool (U, Shift+U cycles the shape tools) should list it in the shape picker (options bar) or Shapes panel under the group path 'Legacy Shapes and More/All Legacy Default Shapes/Nature' as stored in the .csh file; PGD did not drive the picker, so those clicks are inferred, not observed. Drag on the canvas (Shift keeps proportions) and set Fill / Stroke in the options bar.
cards.notes: PGD thumbnail: applied in Photoshop as a custom shape layer (by name and ID), filled near-black on white and fitted to the shape's own aspect ratio. Shapes are single-colour paths: white areas inside the black are holes (cut-outs) in the path, not white paint. Pixel check of the 320 px thumbnail: no fully enclosed white holes; white inside the outline, where present, is open to the outside (a cut channel or gap).

verified.note: Big diagonal leaf with a notch at the top left, a curved white slit splitting off a lower-left lobe and a second notch at the right; one piece.

review.changes: how_to_apply: shape ID given without the leading $, as the renderer passes it
